paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The average probing accuracy using different MLP variations. We indicate the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average probing accuracy differences for various multilayer perceptron variations across two models: mBERT and XLM-R. The horizontal axis represents different multilayer perceptron configurations labeled as hidden:[50], linear; hidden:[], linear; hidden:[100], ReLU; and hidden:[50, 50], ReLU; each configuration specified within square brackets denotes the size and activation function of the hidden layer(s). The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference in probing accuracy with a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2. The bars for mBERT are light blue, while those for XLM-R are dark blue. For mBERT, the bar for hidden:[50], linear is approximately -0.16, for hidden:[], linear it is around 0.09, for hidden:[100], ReLU it is about -0.05, and for hidden:[50, 50], ReLU it is roughly -0.17. For XLM-R, the bar for hidden:[50], linear is approximately -0.04, for hidden:[], linear it is around 0.21, for hidden:[100], ReLU it is about 0.04, and for hidden:[50, 50], ReLU it is roughly -0.14. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and no bars are visually emphasized.
